name: direct probability integral method
definition_zh: 文中直接对随机输入的概率空间进行积分以获得响应概率信息的方法。
usage_overview: 利用代表点的计算响应及其概率权重求取响应概率分布，将随机输入下的响应计算用于极值分布、动力可靠度及累积沉降的概率评估；在概率密度重构中可采用高斯光滑。

complete_examples.text: Furthermore, the direct probability integral method (DPIM) is introduced to implement the uncertainty quantification and reliability assessment of cumulative settle ment, especially spatial distribution, 3D-probability density function and the variation of reliability index with load cycles.

Simultaneously, the direct probability integral method (Chen and Yang 2019) is performed to reveal the spatial characteris tic, instantaneous PDF surface and moment information of settlement subjected to the random soil parameters and dynamic loads, besides, it is extended to evaluate the status of subgrade settlement based on the probabilistic reliability method.
A new direct probability integral method (DPIM) is introduced to achieve the stochastic analysis and reliability assessment of the train-ballasted track–bridge interaction (TTBI) system.

TTBI system Direct probability integral method Stochastic analysis Reliability evaluation A B S T R A C T In this paper, a heavy-haul ballasted track–bridge interaction model is established by the finite element method in matrix representations, and their interaction to the train is achieved by the wheel–rail contact.
